title: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: Half of all life is gone. Five years pass. A van pulls up with a man who has been in a smaller place. The time heist begins.

nodes.text: You drift. The video is for Pepper. The oxygen is low.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
“Save power” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Hope.

nodes.text: The remaining gather. Carol arrives.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Action.

nodes.text: By a lake. Pepper. Morgan. Old friends.

choices.consequence: “Stand” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
“Speak softly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Heart.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Steve goes back to live the life he didn't take. He returns old. He hands the shield to Sam. He sits on a bench by the water with a faded photo.
You watch Pepper and Morgan in the field by the lake. They are, somehow, okay. The world is okay. You give Tony's helmet a small bow.
Whatever the next decade brings, the team is bigger now. Sam carries the shield. Bucky writes letters. You realize a saga doesn't end. It just rolls.
